shadow:
There is a station inside most people, and they are sitting in it, waiting. The train they want has a name. More money. The right person. A stretch of time with nothing owed in it. The wait feels reasonable, because the future does look like it holds something better than this, and so the now becomes a corridor you pass through to get somewhere.

That is expectation. It works by tying a wish to a picture. The wish on its own is clean, it is just the pull toward more life. The picture is the trouble. Once the mind draws the exact shape the good thing must arrive in, every other shape it could have arrived in goes unseen. You walk past the thing you wanted because it did not match the drawing.

Most people call this being let down by life. It is closer to a narrowing.

The way out is not lower expectations. It is noticing that the wait itself was the trap, and that the train was never coming to a platform. It was always already moving, and so were you.
repressive: Some people meet expectation by closing the hand. Nothing is allowed to end, nothing is allowed to change shape. They hold the old version of a person, a season, a self, long past its time, and call the gripping love. The grip slowly dries them out.
reactive: Others meet it by never finishing. To skip the disappointment they skip the commitment, leaving each thing half-built and moving to the next. The cycle they walked out of just reassembles itself further down the line, wearing a new face.
gift:
Something loosens when a person stops needing the day to match the drawing. Detachment is the word for it, and the word is misleading, because it sounds cold. It is not. A detached person feels more, not less. The feeling was always there. What lifted was the layer of wanting it to be other than it is.

You cannot get to this by force. Push a feeling down, refuse a temptation hard enough, and you only tie the knot tighter. Detachment comes the other way. You let the feeling all the way in, you do not flinch from it, and you find you are not obliged to be run by it. You can want something and hold the want loosely in the same hand.

Life starts to read like a book you are both writing and reading at once. You are the one in the story, fully in it, and you are also the one turning the pages, curious, not lost in the words.

The obstacle stops being an obstacle. It becomes the next thing the road had to bend around to take you somewhere you could not have drawn.
siddhi:
Far enough along, the watcher dissolves. Detachment still kept two things, the one observing and the thing observed, and now even that seam closes. There is just the one happening, and it is happening as you.

Every cell is dying from the moment it forms. You are not a fixed thing standing still in the current, you are the current, matter pouring into energy and out again without pause. When the mind stops trying to ride that and simply rests, time goes quiet. The river loses its direction. It comes at you and out of you from everywhere.

What rises then is laughter. Not unkind, the laughter of relief, the body getting the joke it was inside of the whole time.

Look back from here and the long wait at the station is not a wasted season. It was the setup too. The expectation, the disappointment, the ache of the now never being enough, all of it was the slow walk toward the punch line. Nothing is ending. Something is being celebrated.
